body: I had a very similar issue on Godot 4.6.1 stable. I had no problems when using a single 1920x1080 monitor along side my 3840x2160. But when adding another 1920x1080 monitor, the larger display would only render the Godot editor at 1920x1080. No changing of UI scale or auto scaling in the editor settings would solve the problem. What did fix it was the terminal command: ``` user@pop-os:~$ xrandr --listmonitors Monitors: 3 0: +*DP-4 1920/508x1080/286+3000+0 DP-4 1: +DP-6 1920/820x1080/470+1080+0 DP-6 2: +DP-5 1080/530x1920/300+0+0 DP-5 user@pop-os:~$ xrandr --output DP-6 --primary ``` Which set the 3840x2160 as the primary output and fixed all editor rendering issues. Godot v4.6.1.stable (14d19694e) - Pop!_OS 24.04 LTS on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 Laptop GPU - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900HX (32 threads) - 31.07 GiB memory
